evals.prompt: Implement this account summary card in SwiftUI. Our app supports iOS 17 and later. Designers want the new glass look.
evals.expected_output: SwiftUI code using theme values, Dynamic Type, accessibility modifiers, glass effect gated with an availability check and a fallback for iOS 17 to 25, previews and tests.
expectations: Uses `if #available(iOS 26, *)` or equivalent around glass APIs with a fallback
No literal colors or font sizes
Card is combined into a meaningful VoiceOver element
Includes previews for large Dynamic Type
Does not use invented API names
